lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
onlyoffice-main: 554 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 554 B.
onlyoffice-editor: 71 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 71 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,240 B on the onlyoffice-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
9 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (91 packages, 439 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
